create.name: Jennifer Elliott
create.bio:
Jennifer Elliott is a yoga teacher and teacher trainer in the Los Angeles area whose interest in the practice began with a college essay on yoga and meditation. She worked for a time as a massage therapist, qualified as a yoga therapist through Loyola Marymount University in 2008 and holds senior registration with Yoga Alliance. She helped found two yoga teacher-training schools and spent many years leading anatomy, yin and 200-hour trainings for YogaWorks.

Her classes move between strong vinyasa, slow yin and supported restorative work, and she often blends the two in what she calls VinYin, with clear anatomical cues and attention to the subtle body, the chakras and the koshas. She teaches live online classes through Yoga World Heart, sees private students, and has led retreats in Costa Rica, Bali and Greece. She has also taught at yoga festivals, recorded The Revival series of yin and restorative classes for Wanderlust TV, and worked with professional athletes, including a season as yoga teacher for the Los Angeles Rams. On Commune her yin and restorative series License to Chill is part of the membership.

courses.title: Private yoga sessions with Jennifer Elliott
courses.description: One-to-one yoga sessions shaped around the student's own practice and goals, drawing on her yoga therapy and anatomy training. Booked through Yoga World Heart.

free_resources.title: 5 min meditation
free_resources.description: A short guided seated meditation on her YouTube channel, about seven minutes long. It is a simple way to try her teaching voice and settle the breath.

flags: Common name: confirmed as the same person through her site jenniferelliottyoga.com, which links her YouTube channel, Instagram and Yoga World Heart; check no other Jennifer Elliott is already listed.

Only one photo: her YouTube avatar (a yoga pose seen from the side, face in profile). Her site's other images carry quote text; an image near her name on yogaworldheart.com/instructors may be another teacher, so it wasn't used.

Yoga World Heart (online studio) seems to be her own project (her site's Video page points only to it, her YouTube uploads are its classes, and it sells 'Yoga Private with Jennifer Elliott'), but no page says she owns it.
She is a certified yoga therapist (C-IAYT) and sees private clients; her public teaching is general yoga, not psychotherapy, so she was kept.
City set to Agoura Hills from her schedule page (Agoura Power of Yoga; also Equinox Woodland Hills); that page shows only studio logos, with no dates, so check she still teaches in person.
License to Chill is in the Commune membership only (no course page of its own), so there's no Commune offering.
Her site's retreat (Paros, 19–26 Sept 2026) and yin training (2024) have passed and the site looks little updated (© 2024).
